title: Cobblemon: noName
description: This is just a server for me and my friends to play!
body:
This project is just a modpack for me and my friends. It's basically cobblemon, create, farmer's delight and some other support mods. We do not expect anyone from outside our group installing this modpack.

Some features:
- Disabled minecraft vanilla mob spawning (except ender dragon)
- Lots of QoL for cobblemon
- New world generation with terralith and cobblemon structures
